name: semantic-grep
description: A 'search' tool: ranks every function (or file) under a glob by a System One model (Jev, or the open-source decider) against a plain-language query.

base_url.title: System One base URL
base_url.description: Serves POST /v1/systemone. Local decider: http://127.0.0.1:8000. Jev: TypeSafe's API base URL.

batch.title: Decisions per request
batch.description: Max parallel decisions (questions) per /v1/systemone request; a file with more is split.
